title: calamagrostis arenaria subsp. arundinacea
intro: Calamagrostis arenaria subsp. arundinacea, commonly known as tufted reed-grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Calamagrostis arenaria subsp. arundinacea include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and its antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
